title: Modern Favicon Kitchen & Dark-Mode SVG Suite Specification
description: Formal contract definition for modern favicon asset suite generation, dynamic dark-mode SVG CSS styling, multi-platform PWA icon bundles, and minimal HTML5 link tags.

favicon_svg.description: Vector favicon supporting light and dark mode via embedded CSS @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

favicon_ico.description: Legacy fallback multi-resolution ICO file for legacy desktop browsers and RSS readers.

apple_touch_icon.description: Apple iOS Home Screen bookmark icon with Apple HIG safe-zone padding.

icon_192.description: Standard Android Chrome PWA home screen icon.

icon_maskable_512.description: Android Adaptive icon with 10% safe zone boundary to prevent clipping in squircle/circle masks.

webmanifest.description: Standard Web App Manifest JSON registering icons and theme color.

ERR_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT.title: Invalid Image Format
ERR_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT.description: Uploaded file is not a recognized SVG, PNG, WebP, or JPEG image.

ERR_MALFORMED_SVG.title: Malformed SVG Document
ERR_MALFORMED_SVG.description: The SVG content could not be parsed as valid XML.

WARN_LOW_RESOLUTION_SOURCE.title: Low Resolution Source Image
WARN_LOW_RESOLUTION_SOURCE.description: Source raster image is smaller than 512x512 pixels; generated PWA and Retina icons may appear pixelated.

WARN_MISSING_VIEWBOX.title: Missing viewBox in SVG
WARN_MISSING_VIEWBOX.description: SVG lacks a viewBox attribute; automatic scaling across browser chrome may be distorted.

WARN_NON_SQUARE_ASPECT.title: Non-Square Aspect Ratio
WARN_NON_SQUARE_ASPECT.description: Image is not 1:1 square. Icon will be centered with padding to prevent distortion.

INFO_DARK_MODE_INJECTED.title: Dark-Mode CSS Injected
INFO_DARK_MODE_INJECTED.description: Added prefers-color-scheme dark styling to ensure visibility on dark browser tab bars.

INFO_MASKABLE_SAFE_ZONE.title: Adaptive Mask Safe-Zone Applied
INFO_MASKABLE_SAFE_ZONE.description: Scaled icon inside 80% inner core with 10% outer padding for Android maskable icon.

presets.name: Monochrome Auto-Invert
presets.description: Black icon in light mode that automatically turns white in dark browser tabs.

presets.name: Dual-Color Brand Mark
presets.description: Custom color palette with alternate dark-mode accent color.

presets.name: Solid Badge PWA Icon
presets.description: High-contrast geometric badge with rounded background fill for iOS/Android.
